fields.value: Designed and delivered a cross-team feature suggestion system serving multiple product teams, enabling structured product feedback at scale. Modeled hierarchical discussions using self-referential Prisma relations, supporting arbitrarily nested comments and replies with O(1) lookup per node. Implemented soft-delete strategies to preserve thread integrity and auditability across comment lifecycles. Built engagement features (likes, emoji reactions, voting) and email notification workflows for comments, replies, and feature status transitions. Designed a feature lifecycle integrated with Jira, enabling cross-team triage, scheduling, and release tracking from a single interface.

fields.value: DevPal (DevEx Agent) — Enterprise LLM Developer Platform, 18+ Teams

citations.quote: DevPal (DevEx Agent) — Enterprise LLM Developer Platform, 18+ Teams

fields.value: Architected a multi-tenant AI documentation assistant in FastAPI + Azure OpenAI serving 18+ Maersk engineering teams, indexing 1,640+ documents and 1,107 GitHub discussions with 3072-dimension embeddings. Designed a hybrid RAG pipeline: 3-pass LLM shuffle-and-tag ingestion strategy → Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merging tag-based search, vector similarity, and PostgreSQL full-text search — with LLM re-ranking via GPT-4.1-mini before answer generation via GPT-4.1. Eliminated OpenAI Agents SDK overhead by replacing the gpt-4.1 routing agent with a direct gpt-4.1-mini structured output call — reducing P50 response time from 33–40s to 22–27s (∼35% faster) and streaming first token from 37s to 2–5s (10× improvement). Reduced GitHub Discussions initial embedding sync from 55 minutes to ∼5 minutes by replacing sequential per-item API calls with batched embedding generation (100 texts/request). Designed AI Ticket Triage service (TriageService): LLM completeness check → hybrid retrieval → confidence-gated auto-reply (threshold: 0.70) → Hedwig on-call escalation; integrated with MS Teams via Power Automate and GitHub Discussions webhooks; built bot-loop prevention via triage state machine. Built a platform tool registry auto-generated from OpenAPI specs (MDP, MTTS, MRMP, MAC, Stargate APIs) enabling the LLM to fetch live platform data — activity logs, service state, Kafka topics, team rosters — without leaving the chat interface; user bearer token forwarded, no service principal needed. Exposed an MCP server with Azure AD OAuth, enabling DevPal to be consumed as a tool in VS Code, Microsoft Teams, and Jira — adopted by 100+ engineers across the organization. Built a 35-panel Grafana + Prometheus production observability stack; diagnosed and fixed 2 silent instrumentation bugs (fallback counter never incrementing, latency histogram using wrong label) that had been masking real metrics in prod.
